title: Bitcoin Price Trades Near $76,000 as Nasdaq Tumbles into Correction

Bitcoin Price Trades Near $76,000 as Nasdaq Tumbles into Correction

Bitcoin price held near $76,000 Thursday afternoon as the Nasdaq sank deeper into a correction, crypto liquidations topped $1 billion and Strategy, Coinbase and bitcoin miners sold off in double digits.

Core Scientific will finish winding down bitcoin mining in the fourth quarter and enter 2027 as a pure-play AI colocation landlord, with self-mining revenue already down to $12.3 million.

title: Greece Approves 10% Crypto Capital Gains Tax as First Framework Lands Below Draft Rate
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Greece Approves 10% Crypto Capital Gains Tax as First Framework Lands Below Draft Rate

Greece's parliament approved a 10% capital gains tax on cryptocurrencies, the country's first dedicated crypto tax framework, with annual gains up to €500 exempt.

This post Greece Approves 10% Crypto Capital Gains Tax as First Framework Lands Below Draft Rate first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: Bull Bitcoin Becomes First Exchange to Add Payjoin Privacy Deposits, Withdrawals, and Payjoin-by-Default Trading
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Bull Bitcoin Becomes First Exchange to Add Payjoin Privacy Deposits, Withdrawals, and Payjoin-by-Default Trading

Bull Bitcoin is the first Bitcoin exchange to offer Payjoin privacy as a deposit and withdrawal option. Every on-chain buy or sell via BULL Wallet is now a Payjoin by default, automating UTXO aggregation for users while reducing future mining fees and the overall Bitcoin UTXO set.

This post Bull Bitcoin Becomes First Exchange to Add Payjoin Privacy Deposits, Withdrawals, and Payjoin-by-Default Trading first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Juan Galt.

title: South Korea Pushes 22% Crypto Tax to 2029 in Fourth Delay, Offers Three-Year Loss Carryforward
summary:

South Korea Pushes 22% Crypto Tax to 2029 in Fourth Delay, Offers Three-Year Loss Carryforward

South Korea's government will ask lawmakers to delay its 22% crypto gains tax to 2029 and let investors carry losses forward for up to three years.
